quote.text: You don't get paid for activity. You get paid for the close. Everything before the close is just cost.
quote.author: Alex Hormozi

schedule: No calls scheduled — check GHL/Calendly for new bookings before noon.
focus: Still 0 closed from 27+ leads at a $17 CPL — that's roughly $460 spent on people who never booked. The problem is follow-up, not traffic. Run a personal call-and-text blitz through every unbooked GHL lead today with a direct booking link, instead of waiting on automation to warm them.

FB Ads delivery is fading fast: spend dropped to $8.48 on Jun 7 against a $35/day budget, after $20.93 on Jun 5 and $16.45 on Jun 6. The algorithm is pulling back — likely creative fatigue or a narrow audience. Refresh the Missed Call / Two Phones hooks or widen targeting in Ads Manager today before your only live lead source dries up.

FB Ads is your only active channel (Instantly billing lapsed, LinkedIn paused) and it has produced zero clients in 27 leads. Send 20 manual outbound DMs or emails to local home-service businesses today to open a second path to your first close.
gmail_summary: No prospect replies or warm conversations in the last 48 hours, and no billing or security issues that need action. Everything in the inbox is routine: a GGPoker privacy-policy update, a Bank of America Zelle confirmation, a DraftKings deposit receipt, a GoDaddy June account summary, TikTok Shop seller notices (for the separate soccer2college store), and newsletters (NYT, Claude, Kraken). Nothing requires a reply.
